protocol.role: post-selection exhaustive development diagnostic, not confirmation
protocol.groups: Six fixed complementary masks; previous-exposure count, at least five zero-prior candidates, and long-view top3 overlap. No outcome-selected thresholds.
protocol.multiplicity: Intervals are descriptive, unadjusted for model selection or multiple diagnostic comparisons.
protocol.matched_settings: Same learning rate and prior coefficient; each checkpoint keeps its original validation-selected epoch. No new checkpoint selection.

results.note: Paired user bootstrap conditional on fitted seeds; seed average is not a training-population CI. Hate is no-hate utility.
